caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a single antique pistol, shown in three different views on a beige background. The central and largest depiction is rendered in full color and shows a side view of the pistol with a brown, textured wooden grip, and silver or metallic fittings that are decorated with intricate engravings. The barrel of the pistol appears to be metallic with a patterned surface, and the trigger and hammer are clearly visible and also metallic in color. Surrounding the central colored pistol drawing are two smaller, lighter sketches in graphite or pencil: one in the upper left depicting the pistol in profile and one at the lower right depicting the top view, both showing the engraved details of the metalwork and the shape of the grip. The arrangement places the detailed central view prominently, while the pencil sketches provide alternate perspectives of the same object for reference.
title: Dueling Pistol
